id_rule: package::agent_name; never dispatch by bare name

constraints: tool grants are intersection of catalog, policy, and task scope
worker cannot mutate workflow state or approve own output
partial or failed result cannot satisfy a gate

supervision.spawn: SubagentStart validates contract, trust boundary, budget, identity, and permissions
supervision.collect: SubagentStop validates schema, evidence, changed resources, and completeness
supervision.join: Wait for required workers; deterministic aggregate; independent validator checks aggregate
supervision.failure: Bounded retry if retryable; otherwise human handoff; never silently drop worker failure
